title: Pharmacological Characterization of Crotamine Effects on Mice Hind Limb Paralysis
author: Sunamita Lima
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p7wdrpe

steps.title: Prepare Open Field Arena
steps.instruction: Set up an open field arena in a brightly lit room, consisting of a 40 cm diameter area surrounded by 50 cm high walls with a white painted bottom.

steps.title: Administer Infusions and Place Mice
steps.instruction: Administer infusions to the mice and place them into the center of the open field arena.

steps.title: Record Locomotor Activity
steps.instruction: Use a video tracking system and software to record the distance moved and time spent in the entire open field for 1 hour (01:00:00).
